root_cause.text: In amdgpu_userq_vm_validate() in the AMDGPU userqueue validation path, an error goto reused the unlock_all label after drm_exec_fini(&exec) had already been called in the new_addition flow, causing a second non-idempotent drm_exec_fini() on the same drm_exec object.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states that when new_addition is true, drm_exec_fini(&exec) is called before amdgpu_ttm_tt_get_user_pages(), and if that call fails the old code did `goto unlock_all;` where `drm_exec_fini(&exec);` runs again; the patch changes this to `goto free_ranges;` and notes drm_exec_fini() "is not idempotent: it frees exec->objects and may also drop exec->contended and finalize the ww acquire context."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix amdgpu_userq_vm_validate() error handling so failures from amdgpu_ttm_tt_get_user_pages() clean up ranges before unlocking.
intent_record.what: The error path after a failed call to amdgpu_ttm_tt_get_user_pages(bo, range) in amdgpu_userq_vm_validate() was changed from jumping to the label unlock_all to jumping to the label free_ranges.
intent_record.how: On failure to pin or retrieve user pages, execution now follows the cleanup path that frees the collected ranges before proceeding, instead of skipping directly to the broader unlock path; this prevents incomplete cleanup and associated resource leakage or stale state during error handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a dedicated cleanup label for freeing `xa` ranges so failure paths can release them correctly without always passing through `drm_exec_fini()`.
intent_record.what: A new label `free_ranges:` was inserted immediately before the `xa_for_each(&xa, tmp_key, range)` cleanup loop, while the existing `unlock_all:` label remains above `drm_exec_fini(&exec);`.
intent_record.how: This creates an additional jump target so error or exit paths can branch directly to the range-freeing cleanup sequence, optionally skipping `drm_exec_fini(&exec)` when appropriate and ensuring the allocated `xa` ranges are still released.

grouping_result.intent: Add a dedicated cleanup label for freeing `xa` ranges so failure paths can release them correctly without always passing through `drm_exec_fini()`.

consistency_review.core_intent: Refine amdgpu_userq_vm_validate() failure-path cleanup by introducing a dedicated label to free xa ranges before unlocking/finalizing when user-page acquisition or later steps fail.

relevance_review.reason: The changes modify the amdgpu_userq_vm_validate() error-path cleanup flow by adding a dedicated cleanup label instead of reusing the old path, which directly relates to the root cause of incorrect goto-based cleanup sequencing leading to a double drm_exec_fini().

candidates.rationale: This error jump is the direct cause: in the new_addition flow it routes control to unlock_all even after drm_exec_fini(&exec) had already been executed, leading to a second finalization on the same drm_exec object.

This non-idempotent cleanup call at unlock_all becomes unsafe when the earlier goto reaches this label after exec was already finalized, causing the double drm_exec_fini() described in the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This jump is the control-flow bug that routes an error path into the unlock_all cleanup after drm_exec_fini(&exec) has already been called earlier in the new_addition flow, resulting in a second finalization of the same drm_exec object.
This cleanup at the unlock_all path is non-idempotent. It becomes the crashing/dangerous operation when reached via the erroneous goto after the same drm_exec object was already finalized earlier.
